findings.label: M1
findings.text: "Faithful mirror" detection is byte-equality with the *current* renderer, so a future renderer change resurrects the conflict (skills/project-update/update.py:866). A weight.md rendered by an older plugin's mirror() no longer equals render_weight(disk); falls to three_way; sha line differs; conflict every update until a human runs state.py weight --mirror. The header already carries the sha of the JSON it was rendered from. Suggested: decide whether "faithful" means header sha matches disk JSON, or byte-equal to today's render; document if the latter is intended.

findings.label: M2
findings.text: Tests pin only the happy path; the fallbacks that protect a human's data are untested (tests/test_project_update.py:1576-1621): hand-edited weight.md must still go to three_way; stale mirror; missing weight.md created; the except branch (valid JSON, wrong shape); symlinked or absent weight.json. Removing the ours == render(disk) guard keeps both new tests green. Test 1's assertNotIn("weight.md", out) is broad. Suggested: one test for a hand-edited mirror not overwritten, one for an unrenderable JSON falling back without a crash.

findings.text: Stray whitespace edit: SDLC_TEMPLATES =(( lost its space (tests/test_project_update.py:1623). Revert.

findings.label: L2
findings.text: RecursionError (and OSError from the temp dir, an import failure in weight_module()) not caught (update.py:868): a crash of the whole plan instead of the text-merge fallback; not realistic input. Suggested: catch Exception around the render.

findings.text: An aborted apply between the weight.json and weight.md writes leaves the mirror stale; the next run conflicts until a human regenerates it.

label: RISK
title: weight.md faithful-mirror check is byte equality with today's renderer
what: A weight.md rendered by an older plugin's mirror() no longer equals render_weight(disk) after a renderer change; it falls to three_way and the false conflict returns until state.py weight --mirror. Option: recognise a mirror by its header sha256 matching the JSON on disk (review M1 of T-2026-10-30-1347).

label: RISK
title: weight_mirror fallbacks partly untested
what: Covered: faithful mirror, merged JSON, hand-edited mirror. Not covered: stale mirror, missing weight.md, valid JSON of the wrong shape (except branch), symlinked or absent weight.json (review M2 of T-2026-10-30-1347).

label: RISK
title: weight_mirror does not catch RecursionError, OSError or a renderer import failure
what: A deeply nested weight.json, a temp-dir error or a broken weight.py crashes the whole plan instead of falling back to the text merge; catching Exception around the render is always safe (review L2 of T-2026-10-30-1347).

label: RISK
title: an apply aborted between weight.json and weight.md leaves a stale mirror
what: weight.json is written first; an abort before the weight.md item leaves a mirror that matches neither render, so the next update conflicts until a human runs state.py weight --mirror (review L3 of T-2026-10-30-1347).
